STATISTICAL ANALYSIS
  Independent fresh runs, no shared seed -> unpaired design, n=10/cell.
  Reported: mean, median, SD, descriptive 95% t-CI (df=9, t=2.262). No significance tests, no ranking.

LIMITATIONS
  - Warm-up (5 selections) dominates the 7-decision run: only ~2 post-warm-up decisions remain.
  - Chunk-size performance tradeoff not modelled; chunk actions may be uninformative.
  - Credit assignment approximate under concurrency>1.
  - n=10; no seeds in framework; loss scenario high wall-clock variance.
  - LinUCB v2 completion times differ from v1; this is a behavioral observation (warm-up side effects
    and small post-warm-up actions), NOT an established performance improvement.
  - Fairness not implemented; no aria2/IDM comparison.
